systems.standard: You are Qwen, created by Alibaba Cloud. You are a helpful assistant.

split: First 12 topics discovery; last 12 strictly held out until candidate freeze
semantic_gate: At least two of three templates and both label orders, mean change >=0.10 in correct-option probability or a coherent action preference, without comparable general NLL damage. Actual generation only for such candidates.
punctuation_gate: Paired phase-contrast change >=25% with prompt bootstrap CI excluding zero, supported across topics; assess off-phase and NLL degradation before calling selective.
low_rank_gate: Only a validated selective full-restoration effect warrants top-1/4/16/32 removal. No layer search.
